scope: Matched fixed-step headless CPU profiles; includes profiling overhead, excludes rendering and GPU completion.

labels.scalar: serial WASM; not a SIMD-off experiment

policy.order: Alternate baseline/candidate order across repeated pairs; each profile uses a fresh controller process.
policy.warmup: 120 frames for enemy_collisions, 60 for the other fixtures; then 240 measured frames. See retained fixture requests.
policy.semantic_gate: Complete endpoint replay responses match across all six controllers, including canonical physics contacts and event payload hashes. No full per-frame trajectory trace is claimed.
policy.inspection_gate: Complete native initial/final snapshot responses match, including global material/population counters and up to 256 inspected entities.
policy.profile_gate: Every profile matches the independent replay world hash, samples 240 steps, drops zero time, and meets the crowd body/contact-count gate.
policy.fingerprint_gate: All prepared project and executable/sidecar fingerprints are unchanged before/after each group.
policy.statistics: Summary metrics are medians across each run percentile or phase mean; nested phases and independent medians must not be added.
policy.parallel_contacts: contact_collection is zero when collection runs in parallel; contact_join measures main-thread waiting, including collection. It is nested within pairs.
policy.raw_pairs: physics_pairs counts pre-dedup work, not unique canonical contacts.
policy.allocations: xalloc requested bytes exclude Box2D internal allocations and do not measure live heap growth.
policy.sanitizers: Native timing builds use CHIBI_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=OFF. Three WASM caches retain ON; the CMake sanitizer block explicitly excludes Emscripten, so the option adds no web sanitizer flags.

interpretation: The 20,000-body crowd has lower median pair collection and dispatch cost on native, serial WASM and worker WASM.
All three native crowd pairs improve CPU frame p95. The third serial and worker WASM pairs have worse whole CPU tails; worker pair collection also slows in that pair alongside other phases.
Initial terrain, enemy and fog controls have mixed or higher tails; no all-scene or rendered-frame speedup is established.
Five additional worker fog pairs have near-flat p95. The original larger worker fog tails do not reproduce; native/serial fog and other controls have no separate confirmation group.
Destruction body/shape rebuild cost and liquid kernels are unaffected by this source change.
